station_candidate.solution: INPOP17a G+IR, Table 8, printed page 21; visually checked rendered PDF
station_candidate.frame_as_published: Reference values correspond to ITRF2005; fitted station coordinates

limits.time: Table 8 says J2000 and m/year; TT drift scale appears in cited Manche 2011 section 9.1.2. Julian-year implementation would be an explicit interpretation.
limits.tide: Report section 2.3 invokes IERS2010; no explicit permanent-tide flag found. Manche 2011 section 9.1.1 defines regularized positions, section 9.1.3.2 invokes Dehant IERS2003 routine. This supports, but does not independently prove, tide-free INPOP17a station coordinates.
limits.loading: Manche 2011 sections 9.1.4-5 include atmospheric loading and CSR4.0 ocean loading with geocentre correction; precise 2017 choices not restated.
limits.reflectors: Table 9 has apparent errors: L1 reference equals terrestrial MLRS2; L2 reference is at L1 site. Do not silently repair.
limits.header: 402 constants parsed; no station or reflector coordinates. Dynamical constants align with rounded G+IR values but do not repair reflector metadata.
limits.matched: No claim that INPOP fitted coordinates are a DE440 matched station solution or a complete matched INPOP reduction.

recommendation: Candidate for a preselected station-only sensitivity profile after root review, retaining DE440 lunar constants and reflectors. Not yet an unambiguous complete matched reduction; do not choose between G and G+IR using the eleven residuals.
